annotations.title: Common mistakes for a language pair

description: Returns the mistakes SpeakBase's tutor corrects most often for speakers of one language learning another, counted across real lessons (aggregate counts only, shown when enough different learners contribute), plus SpeakBase's false friends or typical mistakes set for the pair and an article where one exists. Good for 'what mistakes do Spanish speakers make in English?'.
name: common_mistakes
title: Common mistakes for a language pair
